title: Makeup Allowance and Makeup Period Carried by Each Snowsports School Product
content:
Two figures are published against every Snowsports School product for makeup sessions: the makeup allowance, being the number of missed sessions that may be made up on another date over the life of the booking, and the makeup period, being the number of calendar days after a missed session within which a makeup session must be booked.

| Product | Makeup allowance (sessions) | Makeup period (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 0 | 0 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 0 | 0 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 0 | 0 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 2 | 21 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 0 | 0 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 0 | 0 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 1 | 14 |

## Notes on the allowance and the period

Two products of the range carry a makeup allowance. The Six-Week Development Programme allows 2 makeup sessions over the life of a booking and carries a makeup period of 21 calendar days; the Elite Performance Camp allows 1 and carries a makeup period of 14 calendar days. The remaining five products carry an allowance of 0 sessions and a makeup period of 0 calendar days.

A block of six sessions with an allowance of 2 leaves four sessions of the Six-Week Development Programme that cannot be made up once missed; a block of five sessions with an allowance of 1 leaves four such sessions on the Elite Performance Camp.
